## Purpose
The top-level shell for the authenticated app: it owns which "main view" is showing (home, library, history, settings, analytics, execution, composer, etc.), mounts the run-chat lane and PreviewPanel for the live execution surface, and bridges pipeline/WebSocket-SSE state into browser notifications and toasts. It also owns the revision handlers (PPT, user stories, prototype, app builder) that re-launch a pipeline from an existing deliverable.

## Shape
- `DashboardLayout(props)` — the component itself; a very large prop surface threaded down from `dashboard/page.tsx` (pipeline state, chat messages, review-gate/questionnaire data, notification callbacks, revision-family data).
- `MainView` union type + `mainView` state — drives which page-level component is rendered (`HomeLaunchGrid`, `LibraryPage`, `WorkflowHistory`, `AccountSettings`, `AnalyticsPage`, `ComposerPage`, or the execution view built from `RunChatLane` + `PreviewPanel`).
- Notification/toast bookkeeping (`useNotifications`, `currentPipelineNotifId`/`currentPipelineNotifRunId` refs, several `useEffect`s) — keeps one notification per concurrent run, guards against a foreign run's terminal event stamping the wrong notification (FIX-194/ISS-060), and fires completion toasts.
- `handleRevisePpt` / `handleReviseUserStory` / `handleRevisePrototype` / `handleReviseAppBuilder` — each builds a revision launch: prefer the REST `postRevision` path keyed on `contentSourceRunId` (the durable parent-run id), else fall back to a legacy text-injection re-launch of the whole pipeline.
- Effects reacting to `pipelineState` — switch to the execution view when a run starts, normalize `od_prototype`/`od_ppt` pipeline types to `prototype`/`ppt`, and reconcile notification progress/gate-pause/completion off generic status markers (never a workflow-name literal, per SC-001/INV-1).

## Why this shape
It is the single composition root for the run screen, so it accumulates the cross-cutting state (notifications, revision-family linkage, concurrent-run tracking) that no single child component owns; the code's own comments describe this as deliberately generic/name-free dispatch (SC-001/INV-1) rather than workflow-specific branching, to keep new deliverable types from requiring new branches here.
